description: great_cto guards for Codex: destructive commands, gate bypasses, a neighbour session's work, secrets in files, frozen gates and weakened checks — plus two context hooks that never block: who depends on a file before it is edited (edit-impact) and a recorded lesson when a call touches what it is about (lesson-tripwire). Shell calls go to the guards as they are; apply_patch is split into one Edit/Write per file first (scripts/hooks/codex-adapter.mjs).

hooks.command: _gd="$PWD"; while [ -n "$_gd" ] && { [ "$_gd" = "$HOME" ] || [ ! -f "$_gd/.great_cto/PROJECT.md" ]; }; do _gd="${_gd%/*}"; done; [ -n "$_gd" ] && cd "$_gd"; _pd="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; [ -n "$_pd" ] || exit 0; node "$_pd/scripts/hooks/codex-adapter.mjs" bash-guards; EXIT=$?; if [ $EXIT -eq 2 ]; then exit 2; fi; exit 0
